info.about: 50 Cent: Blood on the Sand is a third-person shooter video game developed by Swordfish Studios and published by THQ for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It serves as the sequel to 50 Cent: Bulletproof, and was released in February 2009.
info.trivia: It grew out of a cancelled Covert-One project at Swordfish Studios, and 50 Cent recorded 18 exclusive tracks for it.
info.why: It was a commercial failure at launch, so comparatively few copies were ever sold.
